title: JOVRA Room join reveal (jovra.room.join-reveal/1)
description: The guest opens its commitment after receiving hostNonce. The host checks SHA-256('jovra-room-commit|' + guestKeySha256 + '|' + guestNonce) against guestCommitment (reference code commitmentMismatch, which counts as a failed attempt) and derives the verification code from both keys, the QR nonce, hostNonce and guestNonce.
